description: This PHP source file defines a function get_body that generates and renders a template for related modules within SuiteCRM, including filtering and translating module names based on their configurability and accessibility.

methods.name: get_body
methods.description: Generates an array of relatable modules, filters out disabled or certain modules (e.g., Activities), applies translation to module names, sorts them, and then assigns to the Smarty template for display.
